---
name: Bug report
about: Something doesn't work or looks wrong
---

**What happened**

**Where** (episode / level, menu)

**Settings** (Speed Force rate, upscaler, anti-aliasing, resolution scale, output resolution)

**PC** (Windows version, GPU, monitor refresh rate)

**Logs**: attach `install.log` (setup problems) or the game's log. Do not attach game files or saves.
